title: Sandbox — Runner overview
description: Sandbox runner on Dennis: /v1/exec audit outcomes, request latency, errors and the runner container.

options.content:
Every `/v1/exec` call writes exactly one `sandbox_exec` audit record (outcome `completed` / `refused` / `unavailable` / `busy` / `failed`); access lines are `http_request_completed` with `fields.status_code` and `fields.duration_ms`. Log panels need `LOG_FORMAT=json`.

**The gVisor boxes run inside the runner's own dind**, so cAdvisor sees only the runner container: the CPU / memory below include every box the runner is executing, and the boxes never appear as containers of their own.

panels.title: Execs (range)
panels.description: All sandbox_exec audit records, whatever the outcome.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event" | event="sandbox_exec" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome="completed" [$__range]))

panels.title: Refused (range)
panels.description: Rejected before running: timeout too long, invalid or oversized input files.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome="refused" [$__range]))

panels.title: Busy (range)
panels.description: No free exec slot: the runner's concurrency limit was reached.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome="busy" [$__range]))

panels.title: Failed / unavailable (range)
panels.description: failed = the run crashed; unavailable = the inner Docker daemon did not answer.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome=~"failed|unavailable" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "http_request_completed" | json event="event", status_code="fields.status_code" | event="http_request_completed" | status_code >= 500 [$__range]))
sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome" | event="sandbox_exec" [1m]))

panels.title: /v1/exec request latency (ms)
panels.description: End-to-end request time from the access log (http_request_completed, fields.duration_ms): admission, staging, the box run and output collection.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "http_request_completed" | json event="event", http_path="http_path", duration_ms="fields.duration_ms" | event="http_request_completed" | http_path="/v1/exec" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (stack)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "http_request_completed" | json event="event", http_path="http_path", duration_ms="fields.duration_ms" | event="http_request_completed" | http_path="/v1/exec" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (stack)

topk(10, sum by (agent_slug) (count_over_time({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", agent_slug="fields.agent_slug" | event="sandbox_exec" [$__range])))
sum by (level) (rate({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner", level=~"ERROR|CRITICAL|WARNING"}[5m]))

sum(rate({stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "http_request_completed" | json event="event", status_code="fields.status_code" | event="http_request_completed" | status_code >= 500 [5m]))

panels.title: Box run time — completed execs (ms)
panels.description: fields.duration_ms of completed sandbox_exec records: the command's own run time inside the gVisor box.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome", duration_ms="fields.duration_ms" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome="completed" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (stack)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome", duration_ms="fields.duration_ms" | event="sandbox_exec" | outcome="completed" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (stack)
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[5m]))
sum(container_memory_usage_bytes{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"})

panels.title: Restarts / recreates (1h)
panels.description: In-place restarts (start time changed) plus recreates (a new container id appeared). Plain docker compose recreates the container, so changes() alone would miss those.

targets.expr: sum(changes(container_start_time_seconds{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[1h])) + (count(last_over_time(container_start_time_seconds{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[1h])) - 1)
time() - max(container_start_time_seconds{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"})

panels.title: Last seen
panels.description: Seconds since cAdvisor last saw the runner container. Grows when the container is gone.

targets.expr: time() - max(container_last_seen{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"})
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[5m]))
sum(container_memory_usage_bytes{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"})
sum(rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[5m]))
sum(rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{container_label_com_docker_swarm_service_name="sandbox_sandbox_runner"}[5m]))
{stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner", level=~"ERROR|CRITICAL"}

panels.title: Recent sandbox_exec audit records
panels.description: One line per /v1/exec call. Expand a line for the full record (command_sha256, conversation_id, bytes, truncation).

targets.expr: {stack="sandbox", service="sandbox_sandbox_runner"} |= "sandbox_exec" | json event="event", outcome="fields.outcome", agent="fields.agent_slug", exit_code="fields.exit_code", run_ms="fields.duration_ms", refusal="fields.refusal", error_type="fields.error_type", prefix="fields.command_prefix" | event="sandbox_exec" | line_format `{{.outcome}} agent={{.agent}} exit={{.exit_code}} run_ms={{.run_ms}} {{.refusal}}{{.error_type}} cmd={{.prefix}}`
